description: PreToolUse enforces the live-payload-named native spawn delegation channel; SubagentStart records matcher drift but never denies. Compaction hooks create a deduplicated checkpoint skeleton and re-inject the engine-owned PM snapshot without blocking compaction. Execpolicy remains argv-only and cannot enforce spawn metadata.

hooks.command: if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python; else py=; fi; if [ -z "$py" ]; then printf '%s\n' '{"suppressOutput":true}'; else "$py" .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py checkpoint --trigger compaction --phase pre --cwd "$PWD" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; "$py" .project_manager/tools/pm_log.py ctx-guidance --band precompact --json 2>/dev/null || printf '%s\n' '{"suppressOutput":true}'; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $py = $null; if (Get-Command python3 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python3' } elseif (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $py = 'python' }; if ($null -eq $py) { Write-Output '{"suppressOutput":true}' } else { & $py '.project_manager/tools/pm_log.py' checkpoint --trigger compaction --phase pre --cwd $PWD.Path *> $null; & $py '.project_manager/tools/pm_log.py' ctx-guidance --band precompact --json 2>$null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output '{"suppressOutput":true}' } }
